purpose: ADR-091, written on 05.10.2026 before any measurement of it: does the evidence selection keep the passages of the provisions that differ between two versions of an act, now that the server brings them among its candidates, and does the answer state the changes. The first scenario is the turn that failed at the search on 05.10.2026 (scenarios-strengthening-2, the same text and expectations). The second is a national law never measured: its differing provisions fit the eight places whole. The third is the municipal act of scenarios-version-change-1, which passed before ADR-091 and must still pass. The fourth is a control: an ordinary question that names a day on which versions of four national laws start, so the eight places are filled with passages it does not need.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn: the municipality the question asks about; null when it names none
expectation_help.evidence / found_versions_from: search: passages of the act are among the found sources, of the version that ends the day before the asked day and of the one that starts on it
expectation_help.cited / cited_versions_from: answer: it has source blocks that cite both versions
expectation_help.must: answer: it names at least one thing the new version really changes; read the whole answer as well, a pattern is a coarse check
expectation_help.must_not: answer: it does not present an unchanged rule as a change

history: 05.10.2026: written with ADR-091 (#392), before a measurement. Checked free on the server for the first and third question: the differing provisions' passages are among the candidates (36 to 44 candidates).

05.10.2026 evening: measured on release 491de89e (4 turns, 0.0234 USD by the plan's prices). The second, third and fourth scenario passed. The first failed at the search again: the answer described the new section 29 from the act itself, but only the new version was in the evidence. Groups were one per provision then, and an added subsection that runs over two passages brought the new version's first passage of section 29 in without the older one. Groups are one per section since version-change-places-2; that correction is checked by a free replay and not yet measured.

05.10.2026 evening, second measurement: the first scenario alone on release f60b7c27 (0.0056 USD). The older version's passage of section 29 was among the candidates and the selection did not keep it; the turn failed the same two checks. Since version-change-places-3 the server adds the other version's passages of a section the selection kept; checked by a free replay with the model's own selection, not yet measured.

05.10.2026 evening, third measurement: the first scenario alone on release cb1becf5 (0.0060 USD), passed. The selection again kept only the newer version's passages of section 29; the server added the older one, the comparison listed section 29's subsections 1 to 5 with a passage of each version, and the answer compares the wordings and cites both versions.

turns.note: Between the versions of 01.10.2026 and 01.01.2027 sixteen provisions changed, fifteen were added and one was removed (§ 29 on helping a child in need was rewritten: case management and network work; §§ 36¹ and 41³ are new); the one sentence of § 11 and of § 40¹ became their subsection 1. The differing provisions stand in fifteen sections, so the eight places hold a part of them; which part is read from the turn's record.

turns.text: Mis muutub puuetega inimeste sotsiaaltoetuste seaduses alates 1. veebruarist 2027?
turns.note: From 01.02.2027 a child is a child for this act until 18, not 16: § 2 lg 1¹ and lg 2¹ (whose degree of disability is established as a child's), § 2⁴ lg 3 and lg 5 (for how long), § 6 lg 2 (the disabled child's allowance is paid until 18). § 25⁴ is new: the transition for children who turned 16 before that day. Nothing else differs.

turns.text: Mis muutub Põhja-Sakala valla sotsiaalabi korras alates 6. oktoobrist?
turns.note: Until 05.10.2026 today's law is the earlier version and the asked day brings the new one; from 06.10.2026 the new one is today's law and the earlier one is in the search only because an asked day also takes the day before it (legal-validity-2). § 5 lg 5 (a time limit for remedying deficiencies) reads the same in both versions.

turns.text: Kui vald teeb 1. jaanuaril 2027 otsuse, millega keeldub mulle toetust andmast, siis kui kaua on mul aega see vaidlustada?
turns.note: The Administrative Procedure Act's version from 01.01.2027 adds § 7¹ and § 111¹; its rules on a challenge (30 days from learning of the act) read the same in both versions. The answer is the ordinary one; that the added candidates did not displace it is read from the turn's record.
